issues.description: The problem statement and the template describe a Course with a publicly visible 'ratings' property (a var called ratings). The solution, however, makes the ratings property private (private var ratings: [Int]). This visibility difference may confuse students about whether they should access or mutate ratings directly and whether tests or example code expect direct access to ratings. It is an unintentional inconsistency between artifacts about the intended visibility of the ratings field.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the intended visibility of the ratings property consistent across artifacts. Either: (A) update the solution to match the template/problem by making ratings non-private (remove 'private') so students can see and use it directly, or (B) update the problem statement and template to explicitly require encapsulation (e.g., 'ratings should be private; use addRating and getAverageRating to interact with it') so the private modifier in the solution is clearly intentional.
